doc: Leather paper-final results after historical forensic audit (2026-09-28). Replaces provisional 60k fixed-endpoint values (0.872137/0.849932) which remain archived only.
dataset: Leather/Pige: 2341 imgs 768x768; train1638/val235/test468; 7 defect classes + background = 8 eval classes
protocol: historical training (RTX3090-era): constant LR 1e-4 Adam, batch 12, val235 monitoring every 1000 iters, val-best checkpoint saving; current audit: unified test468 evaluation of those checkpoints

base_b.checkpoint_filename_iter_mismatch_note: filename denotes chain target; actual saved iter is the val-best intercept
base_b.selection_metric: val mIoU (8 classes incl background), monitored every 1000 iters during historical training
base_b.test_eval: single final evaluation, TestRescale+ToTensor, no ImageNet Normalize, batch=1, pred=outputs[0], strict load
